description.value: The study examined persistent, dose-dependent alterations in brain activation and functional connectivity associated with long-term smoking abstinence by comparing ex-smokers, smokers, and non-smokers during smoking-cue and control-video viewing.

spans.text: we assessed changes in brain activity and connectivity in ex-smokers with long-term tobacco cessation

description.value: Prospective study of three participant groups: ex-smokers, active smokers, and non-smokers.

spans.text: we used fMRI in a task-based paradigm with smoking-related videos in three populations: ex-smokers (more than 1 year of smoking abstinence); active smokers; and non-smokers.
Forty-six subjects were recruited through local and Internet advertising.
The three groups were matched for gender and age
The local institutional ethical committee approved this prospective and consecutive study.
